record.question: What was the ostensible reason for the English to take up additional fortification of Calcutta?
options: To protect English trade against local rebellion
In expectation of a struggle with the French on the eve of Seven Years war
As a measure of defiance against the weak political and military authority of the Nawab
In order to strengthen their establishment in Bengal
record.explanation: Fortification was ostensibly for a struggle with the French.
